concepts.label: Couchbase Web Console
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - no promoted concept names the Web Console browser GUI itself; the registry only has tls:console-access-setting (whether the console is reachable) and Capella-specific ui-mode:advanced. This page treats the console as the primary access surface for statistics ('Statistics can be viewed by means of Couchbase Web Console...') so the GUI itself needs its own id.

concepts.label: Dashboard (Couchbase Web Console)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the customizable, per-user facility of groups-of-charts on the Web Console's Dashboard tab; no promoted concept covers it.

concepts.label: Bucket Admin (Server RBAC role)

notable_absence.finding: This page's REST section states 'An instance of Prometheus runs on each node' is nowhere mentioned here at all - that sentence only appears on the sibling monitor-intro.md page - yet manage-statistics.md is the page that actually walks through the legacy /pools/default and /buckets/<name>/stats REST endpoints. There is no cross-link from this page to set-up-prometheus-for-monitoring.md or to the Metrics Reference, leaving a reader of the statistics-management page unaware that a second, Prometheus-based metrics surface exists for the same underlying data.

cross_component_finding: The 'Dashboard Access' section draws a real, previously-unmodeled distinction between two access tiers for the same UI facility (ui:dashboard): five roles (Full Admin, Cluster Admin, Read Only Admin, Security Admin, Read-Only Security Admin) see charts for ALL buckets, while Bucket Admin sees charts only for buckets it was granted administrator access to ('The Bucket Admin role allows a user to display of charts of buckets to which they were granted administrator access.') - the same all-cluster-vs-scoped-to-grant split documented for RBAC generally, now confirmed for the statistics Dashboard specifically. None of Bucket Admin, Security Admin, or Read-Only Security Admin existed anywhere in the promoted role: family before this page.
